name: obsidian-vault-mcp
description: Read, search and edit an Obsidian vault on disk, and walk its wikilink graph (backlinks, neighbors, orphans). Works without Obsidian running.

tools.name: list_notes
tools.description: List notes in the vault or a folder

tools.name: read_note
tools.description: Read a note or one heading section

tools.name: get_note_info
tools.description: Frontmatter, tags, headings and link counts

tools.name: get_outgoing_links
tools.description: Links from a note and where they resolve

tools.name: graph_neighbors
tools.description: N-hop neighborhood in the link graph

tools.name: find_unresolved_links
tools.description: Links to notes that do not exist

tools.name: write_note
tools.description: Create a note (overwrite needs a flag)

tools.name: append_to_note
tools.description: Append to a note or heading section

tools.name: edit_section
tools.description: Replace or insert into a heading section

vault_path.title: Vault folder
vault_path.description: The Obsidian vault (the folder that contains .obsidian).

read_only.title: Read-only
read_only.description: Refuse all writes. Turn this off to let Claude create and edit notes.

write_paths.title: Writable folders
write_paths.description: Comma-separated vault folders Claude may write to (e.g. daily,inbox). Empty means the whole vault.

ignore_paths.title: Hidden folders
ignore_paths.description: Comma-separated vault folders to hide from Claude completely.
